title: linux-admin 1.18.15 — iSCSI consolidated into storage
summary: Top-level skill count is now 72. The former iscsi-expert has been retired after initiator/session/target/LUN mapping, stable-device identity and guarded storage-change guidance was preserved and expanded in storage/chunks/iscsi.md. Multipath, NFS, Samba and backup remain separate because their pathing, protocol/authentication and recovery semantics still justify distinct specialists. The latest published GitHub Release remains v1.17.74.
